No active trades or profit/loss activity despite active strategies, suggesting potential issues with strategy execution or market conditions.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review and possibly recalibrate trading strategies to ensure they are aligned with current market conditions and functioning correctly.
Evaluate AI system configurations and logs to diagnose why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and mitigate the root cause, such as inefficient processes or resource leaks.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Audit and test the active trading strategies to ensure they are executing as expected and adjust parameters if necessary.
